root_cause.text: The `imx8m_blk_ctrl_remove()` function contains a malformed loop condition that fails to compare the iteration index `i` against the domain count, causing an infinite loop that results in out-of-bounds access on the `bc->domains` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff corrects the `for` loop condition from `bc->onecell_data.num_domains` (which evaluates to a constant boolean) to `i < bc->onecell_data.num_domains`, ensuring the loop terminates before the index `i` exceeds the valid bounds of the allocated array.
